digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler backend-neutral core (comment/rich-text paths behind the port)
propositions: Backend-neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py load Jira-specific rich-text and comment-limit modules by literal lazy-load key and run them for any configured backend.
A non-Jira backend would still have its comments ADF-encoded and Jira-limit-truncated, so the vendor literal keys are a leak that violates epic bbf1's port-separation goal.
Comment fit-to-limit on the diff path is routed through a new pure FieldSanitizer.fit_comment method that truncates without emitting a send-side warning.
Rich-text decode (ADF dict to text) is routed through InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text, serving both the inbound apply path and the outbound comment-diff decode.
The vendor lazy-key literals are deleted from outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py and enforced absent by a sweep test with a single recorded inbound_fields.py exemption.
The defense-in-depth property that a raw ADF dict never reaches an EDIT event description is preserved backend-neutrally, keeping the bug 1bb2-5da5 regression covered.
